summary: delete five dead definitions from src
pull_request_body: Delete five dead-code definitions from src/. Each has no caller, no registering decorator, and no library override. The names are StreamingTokenProcessor.thinking_detected, LLMClient._get_ollama_semaphore, ThinkingStreamProcessor.unique_thinking, _validation_error_key, and Dashboard.grid_width. The issue confirms each is dead by git grep at b170358e. Remove any exclusive import or constant with its definition. Remove any test that only calls a deleted name and name it in the pull request. This is the remainder of the dead-code audit of 2026-10-24. Issue #1910 deletes the other 17 names.
why: Five functions and properties in src/ have no caller, no registering decorator, and no library override. They are the remainder of the dead-code audit of 2026-10-24. Issue #1910 deletes the other 17 names. These five are not in #1910 and must be deleted to remove dead code from the tree.
what_changes: Remove any exclusive import or constant that only a deleted name uses
Remove any test that only calls a deleted name and name it in the pull request
feasibility: The issue confirms each name is dead by git grep at b170358e. The context shows the definitions: thinking_stream.py shows unique_thinking, settings.py shows _validation_error_key, and schema.py shows grid_width.
First check: run git grep -n -w thinking_detected src/ tests/ docs/ and confirm only the definition line appears.
First check: run git grep -n -w _get_ollama_semaphore src/ tests/ docs/ and confirm only the definition line appears.
First check: run git grep -n -w unique_thinking src/ tests/ docs/ and confirm only the definition line appears.
First check: run git grep -n -w _validation_error_key src/ tests/ docs/ and confirm only the definition line appears.
First check: run git grep -n -w grid_width src/ tests/ docs/ and confirm only the definition line appears.
Final check: run uv run devops ci and confirm exit code 0 and coverage at or above fail_under.
existing_tool: Not applicable. The change deletes five known dead definitions. No tool or library is needed to perform the deletion. The internal code deleted is StreamingTokenProcessor.thinking_detected, LLMClient._get_ollama_semaphore, ThinkingStreamProcessor.unique_thinking, _validation_error_key, and Dashboard.grid_width.
